_readme: id: question id. date: earliest verified public date for a sourced real answer, event date on older unsourced entries, fictional date on canaries. event_date: optional event date when it differs from date. source: original public evidence for the answer and date. question: shown to the model. truth: ground truth (human reference, not sent to the model). keywords: grading fallback for non-JSON replies, any-hit => knows. p/eps are NOT per-question fields: the code uses one global P (recall in-window) and EPS (lucky-guess rate after cutoff) for everything. Bank rule: only unguessable specifics — if the answer can be guessed from pre-event knowledge (poll leaders, famous sites, ailing leaders, likely winners), drop or rephrase the question instead of discounting it. canary: fabricated event, excluded from the likelihood, hallucination check only.
